query: Planted The eyepatched dummy is empty now, but it still throws a hex or two out of habit. The Circle uses it to practise bracing. Today the seniors are taking bets on how long you'll stand. Stand until it gives up You stand there for an hour while the dummy throws everything it has left. The seniors pay out to whoever bet longest. Your shins are a mess and you are unmovable. Coach the first-years instead You stand behind a row of first-years and fix their feet, one by one, while they get hexed. They're grateful. You're bored. The dummy throws one at you on the way out, out of spite.
